``` {r eval = FALSE}
# --- set paths --- #
path_rean <- paste0("data/raw/DominicanRepublic/era5land/monthly/")
path_hind <- paste0("data/raw/DominicanRepublic/hindcast/")
path_fcst <- paste0("data/raw/DominicanRepublic/forecast/")

vars <- c("t2m")

# --- load hindcast and reanalysis with same temporal structure --- #
hind <- c4h_load(path_hind, variable = vars, ext = "nc", month = 5, leadtime_month = 1:6, year = 1994:2016)
rean <- c4h_load(path_rean, variable = vars, ext = "nc", month = 5, leadtime_month = 1:6, year = 1994:2016)

# --- load all forecast data --- #
fcst <- c4h_load(path_fcst, variable = vars, ext = "nc")

# --- convert from Kelvin to Celsius --- #
hind <- c4h_convert_units(hind, variable = vars, from = c("K"), to = c("celsius"))
fcst <- c4h_convert_units(fcst, variable = vars, from = c("K"), to = c("celsius"))
rean <- c4h_convert_units(rean, variable = vars, from = c("K"), to = c("celsius"))
```
